issues.notes: E2 and FCA-007 remain mandatory release blockers under the same-UID threat model. Protocol v5 uses capture-first quarantine-and-verify semantics, a canonical SHA-256 authority-envelope digest, schema-3 receipts, and exact-only legacy handling. Successful renameatx_np with RENAME_EXCL is the capture linearization point. Namespace-exact mismatch and post-capture metadata change retain the object in root-owned quarantine; content-exact fails closed. This is mitigation, not elimination. Public macOS descriptor-relative open, stat, unlink, rename, renameatx_np, descriptor, fcntl, fsync, and F_FULLFSYNC interfaces do not combine terminal namespace mutation with an expected device, inode, vnode generation, or content token. Source-parent authorization and capture are not atomic: same-UID relocation can move the validated pinned parent outside the authorized root before capture. One winning race can delete one eligible outside-root regular file or symlink whose bytes are unbounded, or quarantine one ineligible directory whose subtree is unbounded. The final ACL/BSD-metadata-check-to-unlinkat race can delete one already captured expected regular file or symlink after its authorization metadata changes; regular-file bytes are unbounded. Terminal quarantine has no authorized restore, release, or purge disposition and cannot be acknowledged while the protected leaf exists; 32 conflicts can exhaust every protected slot on one volume. Caller-ledger removal, relocation, or lock-inode replacement and project-generation races can strand or allow up to 32 captured or terminal transactions per protected volume; each affected regular file can contain unbounded bytes. Writable descriptors and hard links prevent an exact immutable-content guarantee. Startup recovery fencing, terminal physical-state repair, caller-ledger and generation fencing, daemon-owned discovery and revoke, project-binding revoke and garbage collection, qualified external/removable volume behavior, whole-product freshness, direct daemon execution, and the full signed distinct-process 57-row crash, adversarial, lifecycle, volume, hard-link, writable-descriptor, Release, and notarization matrix remain open. Source checkpoint 2dd504e53a5a09837cd289a99eee48ab7f4547eb adds evidence-control schema v2 and artifact-binding schema v1, recorder-owned evidence-specific copies, exact case/role/iteration/subject/predicate/fact and qualification-context binding, current-manifest and Git execution identity checks, bounded descriptor reads, and pathname replacement/rewrite negative tests. The evidence-control suite passed 57 of 57 tests in the final repeated validation. The template remains partial with all 57 rows not_run, all 12 formal predicates false, zero formal references, and a null qualification-context reference. These are controls only: they do not execute a signed distinct-process case, prove a claim true, provide an identity-conditional macOS mutation, or close any formal predicate. Qualification still assumes a trusted quiescent workspace against same-UID transient source-manifest replacement; an arbitrary caller-selected harness is not authenticated; aggregate report and evidence input reads remain unbounded fail-closed denial-of-service surfaces; and the G10 handler does not yet invoke this checker. Post-verification mutation also remains outside immutable-content proof. E2, P10, G10, and G12 remain open; G09 continuity, G11 hardware, native signing/UI, shell qualification, and final release qualification also remain release-blocking.
